## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 10, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Sylvia Molina_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "I hate this app. I'm regularly charged late fees because the app crashes a lot. Whenever I try using the "Support" option, it tells me that my connection isn't working and that I need to connect to WiFi and when I do it still gives me a can't connect message. I'm convinced that this is why my bank account isn't being charged on the 17th of each month and there's no option to pay until it's late on the App. I'm sure the company purposely does this to get more money out of us in late fees."
            2. _R J_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "App update sucks. QR not working.. . laggy...... terrible organization....... high school programmers have better apps in their projects 😂"
            3. _AJey Calloway_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined Planet Fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter Planet Fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
